newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Properties sees loss for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Properties sees loss for 1996.

text.p: Shenzhen Properties & Resources Development (Group) Co Ltd is likely to report a loss for 1996 on poor office sales, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Many of the company's office blocks in Shenzhen remain unrented and unsold, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin but declined to give a loss figure.
The company is burdened with interest payments on its more than 100,000 square metres (1.09 million square feet) of unsold space, he said.
Company results have little hope of improving significantly in 1997 and 1998 as the commercial property sector is seen as remaining sluggish, he said.
Shenzhen Properties reported an unaudited net profit of 14.7 million yuan in the first half of 1996 and 215.0 million yuan in 1995 under Chinese accounting standards.
The spokesman gave no further details.
Shenzhen Properties's foreign currency B shares were last traded at HK$4.10 on March 27, and its domestic currency A shares ended closed on Monday at 11.04 yuan.
